subject: Runs fine on local, but not on ShinyApps. Large data used.

messages.author: 75da3d7c3d5ae2d0
messages.subject: Runs fine on local, but not on ShinyApps. Large data used.
parts:
Hello ShinyApps support,

I've completed my Shiny app on my local machine. It runs fine. I opened a Shiny app account and have successfully uploaded my app to the server. I can access my app however, it won't display the plots that were displayed when I was running the app on my local machine.

It displays the message: "An error has occurred. Check your logs or contact the app author for clarification."



Would you be able to see what the problem is. My application is at:

https://nbaportal.shinyapps.io/nbaportal/

Possibly pertaining to this problem, I would also like advice on whether I should purchase an upgraded plan to allow a larger instance for faster loading. Here are some notes on my app:

1. App loads 50 megs of data from .csv files
2. Libraries called: shiny, shinydashboard, plotly and dplyr
3. After each input, app redraws a plotly plot with 30 lines.

Please let me know of your advice on 1) troubleshooting and 2) should I go for an upgraded plan to speed up the loading of data.

Sincerely Yours,
Donny

Support is available with paid plans.
